children: it has priced an underwritten registered direct offering of 833,334 ordinary shares at $0.60 per share and pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 24.17M ordinary shares at $0.5999 per warrant.
The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable and will remain outstanding until exercised in full. All shares and warrants in the offering are being sold by Arbe.

The company expects gross proceeds of about $15M before underwriting discounts, commissions and other offering expenses. The offering is expected to close around Sept. 28, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

Arbe plans to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes, including scaling operations to support commercial opportunities, its recently announced selection for an L3 passenger-vehicle program of a major global automaker, expansion into defense and counter-drone markets, and potential strategic M&A.

title: Arbe Robotics prices $15M equity offering
